messages:
leah-marketing: Heads-up: product + sales asked for a short one-pager aimed at enterprise buyers (security/SLA/deploy modes) plus a 2-page field playbook for AE/SE handoffs. Need something crisp for next week's webinar follow-up and the launch email. Can someone draft?
tom-product: I can draft the customer one-pager. Will include a compact decision guide (when to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and a small benchmark callout. Harry, can you give 2-3 SE bullets on provisioning time and perf tradeoffs?
harry-se: Sure. Key bullets: Hosted = instant trial, standard psuedo-SLA ~99.9% for API; Dedicated = reserved GPUs, best for sustained >500 rps, typical SLO 99.95% when committed; Private = VPC/on-prem for regulated workloads, integrates with KMS/HSM and audit trails, provisioning lead time 2-8 weeks depending on infra. Note: mention quantization/latency tradeoffs and KV/prefix caching reduces cost for repeated contexts.
nisha-sales: For the field playbook Ill own routing and qualification. Proposal: add MQL form flags: compliance_required (bool), expected_peak_rps (number), data_residency (region), air_gapped (bool). Routing rules: compliance_required -> AE+Legal+SE; expected_peak_rps>500 -> flag for Dedicated; air_gapped -> private track + solutions-eng. Also include a short objection play: "We need guarantees" -> "We offer Dedicated with SLA in contract; legal can scope penalties per enterprise agreement".
clare-legal: Quick legal note: don't state contractual guarantees in customer-facing collateral. Use phrasing like "typical SLOs" or "example SLOs under commit". Add privacy line: "Customer content processed per contract; Redwood will not use customer data to train models without consent." Also include HSM/KMS mention for Private deployments.
leah-marketing: Helpful. For the webinar follow-up email and launch post we want a 1-paragraph lead, bullets for benefits, and a single-row decision matrix graphic (we'll design). Also want a 1-line benchmark blurb we can include in the one-pager and the blog's sidebar. Keep numbers non-actionable (e.g., "sample throughput: 8k tokens/sec on Dedicated example config").
tom-product: Adding a fallback/resilience sentence: "Smart routing automatically falls back to compatible model variants and regions when capacity is constrained." Good for enterprise continuity narratives.
harry-se: Demo checklist snippet for SEs to include in playbook: "1) Run 5-min smoke with customer sample workload. 2) Verify KV/prefix cache warms within N requests. 3) Validate p95 latency meets target. 4) Confirm encryption at rest with KMS. Command example (pseudo): `smoke_test --model example --seq 1024 --clients 6 --duration 300`"
nisha-sales: Also adding inbound score: give +10 if compliance_required, +5 if expected_peak_rps>1000, +3 if EMEA residency (local sales resource needed). Any lead with score>12 -> enterprise AE.
leah-marketing: I'll stitch the copy. Timeline: I'll push draft one-pager + playbook to marketing-assets by Fri EOD. Tom/Harry/Nisha/Clare please review by Thu noon so we can finalize for webinar follow-up list.
asset-bot: Reminder: after approval, upload final assets to marketing/assets/enterprise and create share links for AE kit.
clare-legal: I'll drop approved legal snippets into the doc comments by Thu morning (privacy + SLA phrasing).
leah-marketing: Great work team. After upload I'll create a short tracking doc for conversion metrics from webinar -> SE consults -> POC. We'll iterate messaging after first 2 weeks of calls. :sparkles:
